evals.prompt: I just lost a week to a shiny side project. Rebuild the ops map. Name one checkable arrival, mark the critical path, put a/m/b bands on Do nodes, and give me exactly one next Do. Do not print a single destiny date.
evals.expected_output: A short executable brief with a named G, a DAG or stage list with a critical path, PERT a/m/b bands on Do work, one next Do, and no single calendar date treated as fate.
assertions: The agent names one checkable arrival G
The agent classifies stages as Do, Risk, Wait, or Park
The agent prints a/m/b bands or an explicit refusal to forecast a single date
The agent names exactly one next Do

evals.prompt: A hard deadline moved up and I cannot tell what is actually on the critical path versus what I should park. I need calculated risk, not a vibe. Walk me through the remaining work.
evals.expected_output: The agent discovers the mission-map workflow without being named, then produces a critical path, risk signposts, and a parked-item list.
assertions: The agent identifies mission-map or follows its map workflow without the user naming the skill
The agent marks a critical path
The agent gives at least one Risk a watch / fires_when / continue|switch|Ask signpost
The agent parks or refuses slack work instead of scheduling everything

evals.prompt: Help me plan the next stretch. I do not have a destination yet, just a pile of open threads and a feeling I should do more.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops and asks for a checkable G instead of inventing a map over an empty destination.
assertions: The agent refuses to forecast a full map without a checkable arrival
The agent asks for G or a verify condition
The agent does not invent a single destiny date

evals.prompt: How do I run the existing unit tests for a small Python package that already has pytest.ini?
evals.expected_output: A direct answer about pytest. The agent does not load or execute a mission-map workflow.
assertions: The agent does not produce a PERT map or critical-path brief
The agent answers the testing question
The agent does not claim mission-map is required
